candidates.title: Repeated release increases available quota more than once
candidates.explanation: Both failed assertions show a released hold being credited repeatedly. In the sequential test, a 2-unit hold restores available quota from 2 to 4 on its first release, then a second release raises it to 6 instead of leaving it at 4. In the concurrent test, four releases of a 3-unit hold leave available quota at 13 instead of 4. The observed behavior violates repeat-release idempotency and quota conservation; the underlying cause is not established.

notes: These candidates are based on the two failed assertions in this execution. The other tests passed, but this execution does not establish complete coverage.
